behaviors.behavior: SmartViewer (.smart-viewer-markdown) markdown table header/data cells vertical-align to top instead of the browser default middle, and the shared/unscoped .markdown-body table th/td rule used by ~5 other DocumentMarkdown consumers is left untouched
behaviors.evidence: client/src/test/markdown-table-vertical-align.test.ts (source-rule fence); live-Chromium computed-style probe against the actual index.css confirming the two selectors resolve differently at runtime

surface_verification.justification: Throwaway real-Chromium probe (Playwright headless) loaded the actual index.css against a two-table fixture (inside vs outside .smart-viewer-markdown) and read getComputedStyle().verticalAlign: scoped=top, unscoped=middle on both header and data cells.
